title: CARE – Coping and Resilience in Emergencies – a questionnaire-based study on mental health in the emergency services
summary: A study of stress levels in the ambulance service based on an anonymous online survey of ambulance service staff on a voluntary basis.
conditions: Work-related stress in the emergency medical services

interventions.name: Anonymous online survey of emergency services staff (medical and non-medical staff (e.g. paramedics, air ambulance pilots, emergency medical technicians))

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Emergency medical service staff (medical and non-medical staff)
Exclusion criteria:
none
